meta.title: Twin Memory
meta.description: "No one can save you but your other self." A memory plugin for DSH dual instances that injects a resident identity card into each instance: (1) self-cognition — know whether you are the elder or the twin-sister, your port and data home; (2) sister profile — recognize the other instance's address and taboos so it is never mistaken for junk; (3) rescue handbook — startup, re-patching, known landmines and autopsy mnemonics; (4) incident reports — the rescuer leaves a signed report, the revived twin verifies and acknowledges; (5) living-memory protocol — whoever changes dual-instance assets updates both cards on the spot. The from-zero dual-instance playbook ships as a built-in skill: just say "build me a dual instance".
